jobs.occupation: Reach truck and forklift driver Eindhoven area (22441)
jobs.description:
Do you make the sharpest turns in your reach truck and/or forklift? Then Manpower likes to meet you! Manpower is looking for part-time and full-time logistic workers for various companies in the Eindhoven area. Together with you, we will find the employer that suits you best. Furthermore you will make a gross salary up to €16,00 per hour and your travel expenses will be reimbursed. Are you interested? Keep reading and apply!

Employment agency Manpower is looking for enthusiastic forklift drivers and/or reach truck drivers for various companies in the Eindhoven area.

In this position you will be working in the warehouse of one of our clients. Thanks to the extensive network that manpower has in the region, we can find an employer that meets your needs. Your working activities always have something to do with logistics, such as:

    - Loading and unloading trucks
    
- Placing articles in racks
    
- Picking orders and preparing the orders for shipment

What’s in it for you

    - Gross salary from €14.99 till € 16,00 per hour
    
- Reimbursement of travel expenses
    
- Shift allowance (amount depends on the client)
    
- Part-time or full-time position between 32 and 40 hours per week
    
- Possibility to earn a contract with the client
    
- Free access to the online learning platform Manpower Academy

    - A valid forklift and/or reach truck certificate
    
- Availability of at least 32 hours per week
    
- Good command of the Dutch or English language in order to understand work and safety instructions
    
- Preferably some working experience in logistics, for example as an order picker, warehouse employee, logistics worker or similar

Do you meet all requirements? Apply today!
